name: Frontier Bridge (local context packager)
purpose: Assemble a Claude-written prompt + selected local files into ONE copy-paste pack the user manually carries to their own external model session, plus read the pasted answer back. LOCAL-ONLY, NO-NETWORK: never contacts any external AI service (D-0052).

invocation.args_spec: Named params or -InputsJson '<object>'. Action: pack | read-return. See inputs.

inputs.name: question
inputs.description: The specific question, emphasised at the end of the pack.

inputs.name: paths
inputs.description: Explicit file paths and/or globs to include.

inputs.name: folder
inputs.description: A folder whose files are included.

inputs.name: max_file_bytes
inputs.description: Skip any single file larger than this.

inputs.name: max_total_bytes
inputs.description: Stop including files once the pack would exceed this.

inputs.name: out_name
inputs.description: Base name for the pack file.

inputs.name: return_file
inputs.description: pack: override the return-file location. read-return: the file the user pasted the answer into (required for read-return).

inputs.name: expect_pack_id
inputs.description: read-return: optional pack_id (the pack's invocation_id) to validate that the return file belongs to the expected pack.

outputs.description: pack: {pack_path, manifest_path, return_file, file_count, total_bytes, skipped_count, boundary, instructions_for_user}. read-return: {return_file, bytes, sha256, encoding, format, pack_id, expected_pack_id, pack_id_match, captured, valid, char_count, issues, content}.
